definitions.ndcg: Gain 2^grade-1; log2(rank+1) discount; ideal ranking from the persona-specific common pool across all arms and turns.
definitions.precision_5: Relevant among first five divided by five, also for short result lists.
definitions.rr_10: Single-person reciprocal rank of first relevant item among first ten; zero if none; NA if no judgment universe.
definitions.mrr_10: Equal-weight mean of available individual RR@10 values at a fixed arm/turn; n is shown.
definitions.missing: Missing snapshots and undefined metrics are null/NA, never fabricated zeroes.
definitions.delta: Within-person change from the same arm at T0; aggregate only complete pairs.
definitions.arm_differences: Contemporaneous within-person paired arm differences; change differences require all four relevant values.

limitations: Two deliberately constructed synthetic personas; repeated snapshots are not independent participants.
One stochastic session per persona/arm; descriptive only, without significance tests, confidence intervals or general causal claims.
Codex-created profiles and judgments; no independent human gold standard.
Pool-relative nDCG, not an ideal ranking established over all 8,537 jobs.
These are ranking metrics, not measures of chat quality, usability, participant satisfaction or real-world employment outcomes.
Additional facts disclosed during chat can improve ranking; changes are not attributable to personality alone.
